25003.notes: Massachusetts tax-title is municipal, not a single county auction (M.G.L. c. 60). Northern, Middle, and Southern Berkshire Registries of Deeds are separate. No centralized county tax-deed mega-sale — track each municipal treasurer. Western Mass / Berkshires tourism and medical employment.

42033.notes: Pennsylvania Tax Claim Bureau county (RETSL). Pre-registration form required (PDF on county site). 2025 Tax Sale List published; historic venue includes Clearfield County Fairgrounds (e.g. Sept 20, 2024 10:00 a.m. public tax sale). Contact Tax Claim at 814-765-2641 ext. 5006 for 2026 Upset date and Conditions of Sale. North-central PA / I-80 corridor.

51085.notes: Virginia judicial tax-deed county (Code of Virginia §58.1-3965 et seq.) — not tax-lien certificates. Hanover County Treasurer sells real estate delinquent on Dec. 31 following the second anniversary of the due date. At least two real estate auctions per year; lists final ~3 weeks prior and posted on county calendar. Auctions on steps of Hanover County Board Room or online at forsaleatauction.biz; notifications also via taxva.com. Winning bid subject to Circuit Court confirmation. Special warranty deed; property sold free of liens and encumbrances per county materials. Richmond north suburban / I-95 corridor.

auctionPlatform.label: Hanover County Treasurer — Delinquent Tax Sale / forsaleatauction.biz

51085.auctionFrequency: At least twice per year when inventory is ready; watch county calendar and taxva.com / forsaleatauction.biz
51085.depositRules: Highest bidder normally pays deposit of 25% or $1,000 (whichever higher) plus 10% buyer’s premium on final bid. Certified bank funds or wire only. Must not owe delinquent taxes to Hanover or be defendant in pending tax matter. Purchaser pays recording and future taxes; title insurance is buyer’s cost. Court confirms sale.

51085.quietTitle: Court confirmation is primary clearing; some insurers still want quiet title on notice-sensitive parcels.

51161.notes: Virginia judicial tax-deed county (not Roanoke City — this is Roanoke County). 26017.notes: Michigan tax-foreclosure (MCL 211.78 / PA 123) county — not a lien-certificate sale. After multi-year forfeiture, Circuit Court foreclosure (typically March 31 cycle) vests title in the County Treasurer as Foreclosing Governmental Unit; remainder parcels sell at public auction AS IS by quitclaim-style deed. Bay County 2026 auction for tax-foreclosed parcels: virtual on August 3, 2026 via tax-sale.info (Title Check, LLC); bidding opens 30 days prior. Excess proceeds claims under MCL 211.78t / Rafaeli framework (Form 5473 etc.). Historic 2015–2020 surplus claims also referenced on county page. Saginaw Bay / industrial mid-Michigan.

auctionPlatform.label: Tax-Sale.info (Title Check, LLC) — Bay County public land auction

26017.auctionFrequency: Annual summer public auction after March foreclosure (2026: Aug 3 virtual; bidding opens ~30 days prior); second-round sales possible statewide
26017.depositRules: Register on tax-sale.info; deposit and terms per auction catalog. Minimum bid generally equals taxes, interest, penalties, and fees. Sold AS IS/WHERE IS; purchasers release Treasurer from liability per county notice. Confirm current cycle deposit with Title Check / Bay County Treasurer.

clerkOfCourt.label: Bay County Register of Deeds / Circuit Court (foreclosure judgment)

26017.survivingLiens: Circuit court foreclosure is intended to convey free of most prior private liens, but federal tax liens and some interests may survive. Special assessments, demo orders, environmental issues, and occupancy create practical risk. Excess proceeds go to prior owners via statutory claim process — not a windfall auction model.
26017.quietTitle: Judgment of foreclosure is the primary clearing step; some insurers still require quiet title or extended curative work on tax-foreclosed deeds.
